messages:
Maya: Heads-up: we saw another spike with missing spans and skewed aggregates during last night's deploy window. Looks like a parsing regression in aggregator.
Theo: Can you paste the error lines? I want job IDs to plan backfill.
Maya: From etl-agg-2026-03-22: `ERROR aggregator.deserialize: unexpected token for optional_field 'span_variant' -> drop` — full logs in incident doc.
Ravi: I traced it: collector v3.3 added an optional enum field. Aggregator's strict enum decoder threw and dropped entire payload.
Priya: We also had ETL ingestion lag up to 55m as workers restarted with new image; checkpoint commits stalled during that time.
Maya: Proposed actions:
- ACTION-1021: Safe backfill for dropped spans (owner: Theo) - target: 2 business days
- ACTION-1022: Make aggregator tolerant to unknown enum values + unit + golden tests (owner: Ravi) - target: PR in 24h
- ACTION-1023: Add span_coverage SLO alert and a per-service dropped_span_rate metric (owner: Priya) - target: EOW
Theo: I'll run a scoped backfill. Dry-run first. Script:
```
./bin/backfill_traces --job=agg-backfill --from=2026-03-21T00:00Z --to=2026-03-22T06:00Z --dry-run
```
Theo: After dry-run I'll do 3h batches with watch on job_latency and influx counters.
Ravi: Working on code change: adding unknown-enum fallback -> LOG.warn + preserve fields. Also adding fuzz test for future optional fields.
Priya: I'll create a Grafana panel with per-service dropped_span_rate and hook an alert: trigger if dropped_span_rate > 0.5% for 15m.
Maya: Interim mitigation if backfill delayed: pin collector in the affected region to v3.2.x and pause rollout. @releases-bot can you flag if any more collector rollouts are scheduled?
releases-bot: There are pending collector rollouts for us-east-1 at 2026-03-23T02:00Z. Recommend hold until aggregator fix is live.
Theo: Dry-run finished: preview counts align with expectations, no rejects. Starting first live batch in 45m and monitoring.
Ravi: PR: github.com/redwood/aggregator/pull/427 - includes tolerant decode, unit tests, golden payload.
ci-bot: CI: running regression suite. Will block merge on any acceptance test failures.
Maya: Let's schedule daily 10m standups until all actions are closed. Also add this incident to the postmortem tracker with owners and due dates.
Theo: Backfill batch 1 completed: 1.2M spans re-ingested, no backlog. Posting run logs to ops ticket.
Priya: Dashboard link pushed in ticket: https://grafana.redwood/s/Traces/dropped-spans. Alert created: TRC-21.
Maya: Closing loop: make sure we add a regression test in the release checklist to validate aggregator against new collector payloads before rollout.
Ravi: A follow-up: propose a small protocol compatibility spec to avoid future unknown-field drop cases.
Maya: Thanks all. We'll keep updates here and mark ACTION-1021/1022/1023 in the remediation board. Will reconvene in 24h for status.
